out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM MUST BE ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION OF THE KITCHEN INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. PLEASE CONSIDER HAVING OTHER KITCHEN STAFF OBTAINED CERTIFICATION. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE END OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE AT 54-57F IN TRAULSEN 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; MILK AT 46-50F IN CARAFES; CREAM AT 43F AND SALSA AT 59F AT BREAKFAST SERVICE STATIONS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INDICATED FOODS WOULD BE DISCARDED AT 9:00 AM. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH FOOD ITEMS AND COFFEE FILTERS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections IN AREA OF DISHWASHING MACHINE AND 3 COMPARTMENT SINK piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. OBSERVED EXPIRED QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST KIT ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: CFM PLACED ORDER FOR TEST KIT DURING INSPECTION.
